notes.title: Donations patch!
notes.content:
You can now make small donations via website or while inside the game!

Thanks a bunch!

notes.title: Fixed bugs! Fixed Shop!
notes.content:
Adjusted shop prices to be displayed with scientific numbers.

fixed some bugs related to latest patch of stats not being displayed properly...

notes.title: Scientific numbers patch!
notes.content:
Some of the attributes in the game will now be displayed as

100M = 100 million
100B = 100 Billion
100T = 100 Trillion
100Q = 100 Quadrllion


Lets see how this will evolve and work!

notes.title: Fixed "text" Fixed Drinks !
notes.content:
Fixed "text" showing up above learn.

Fixed Drinks prices not reseting after ascend.

notes.title: Fixed latest patch bugs!
notes.content:
Fixed couple of bugs on the academy(Buttons werent working)


Nerfed ascend even more....

notes.title: Fixed bugs!
notes.content: Fixed bugs on newest patch where you would loose your money when withdrawing from bank!

notes.title: Bank Update!
notes.content:
I added Bank and 60 new stages to the game....

This way you can play for longer.

I was planing this patch if we ever reach 50 reviews! and we did it!

Now I am planing an hughe patch for the 100 reviews! If we get there!

Thanks everyone for contributing and helping me with our game!

Thanks!

notes.title: Fixed Drink menu Bug
notes.content: Fixed some bugs related to the Drink Menu

notes.title: New Game??
notes.content:
Added conformation question before starting new game....

This should prevent you from accidentaly deleting your save file....

the following should be 

New Game - > Start ( then a new game begins)


Thanks again!

notes.title: Cant Click Bug!
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where you couldnt click anything after defeating the hoodman.

This bug showed up on latest patch I broke things apprently.

Well anyways now things are working normally.

notes.title: Fixed click - fast BUG!
notes.content: Fixed a bug that when clicking fast on certain would lead to strange results.

notes.title: New things in new patch!
notes.content:
I made some adjustments....

Audio mute/unmute button should only appear on screen after menu appears as well. it will be inactive until then.

I changed the menu screen of the Orc fights to match the new model introduced in the latest patch.

I changed the font of enrgized from black to white.

I added more 60 dungeon levels since players are playing for longer then what I expected.


Thanks a bunch everyone!

notes.title: Fixed 100000000000000000 HP bug!
notes.content:
1. Fixed  a bug where hp wouldnt rest to the standard 20 after ascending.


Thanks =D

notes.title: Fixed Ascend Bug!
notes.content:
1. Fixed Ascend bug( You couldnt ascend before because the required level for ascending is 30)
so I changed the display message to show required level 30 so you dont get confused.

2. Fixed Str and Dex and Wisdom they are no longer float numbers.

notes.title: Fixed some bugs related to the patch!
notes.content:
1. Ascend has been nerfed. It was too strong before.

2. You can no longer use the skills you havent learnt at the Academy

3. Fixed a gamebreaking bug that wouldnt let you click on anything after ascending.

notes.title: Some bugs on new patch I am taking care of them!
notes.content: There are bugs on the new patch I am studying and taking care of them please be patient

notes.title: Small Expansion Lets say??
notes.content:
Well whether you consider this an expansion or a small patch is up to you!

This time I bring you guys SKILLS and an ACADEMY also PRESTIGE Ressurection Bonuses!

1. Introducing SKILLS there are 3 Skills that can be biught with Wisdom... 

2. Use the SKILLS in Battle with the new Mana System!

3. Reached level 25?? You can now ressurect and start from level 1 You will keep extra stats from doing that!

notes.title: Fixed even more things!
notes.content:
Hello guys I heard from one of the reviews people werent being able to save theyr customized character.
Well  now you can do that!

Fixed custom characters , it now saves.

Added level and gold information at the dungeon.

You can now see how much gold you have when you visit the shop!

added 60 more difficulty levels since I heard game was being too easy on you guys!

thanks everybody for contributing!

notes.title: Mute-Unmute Patch!
notes.content:
As title suggests I fixed Mute and Unmute function. 

Whenever you select the audio to to be mute now the game will be muted.

I also enlarged even more the dialogues and some texts so people can read it better.

notes.title: Cool Update!
notes.content:
Hey guys I decided to make some changes to the game in order to improve it.

Here they are:

1. Added character customization

2. You can now choose between 3 names

3. Fixed and adjusted swords and shields balance to match new Balance system

4. Enlarged some of the story texts so people can read better.

5. I believe the game now runs on the background, If it still does not then I am sorry.

6. Removed Save slots. I didnt manage to make them work decently

7. Bug fixes that kind of stuff.
